subject: Your gift restores 200 meals this week — match ends Friday
preheader: Spring hunger relief: every dollar unlocks pantry staples for families and seniors in our county. Corporate match doubles impact through Friday midnight — see where funds go, meet a volunteer, and give in one secure link.

content.headline: Neighbors still choosing between rent and groceries
content.subheadline: This spring campaign funds pantry boxes, weekend kids packs, and home delivery for seniors — your gift ships this month.
content.imagePrompt: Volunteers packing grocery bags in bright community room, diverse hands, hopeful atmosphere, documentary nonprofit photography, no readable labels

items.heading: Pantry staples
items.description: Rice, beans, eggs, and fresh produce bundles sized for a family of four for one week.
items.imagePrompt: Colorful fresh produce on wooden table, soft natural light, editorial food bank story, no packaging text

items.heading: Weekend kids packs
items.description: Discrete bags for schoolchildren — ready-to-eat items that do not require cooking.
items.imagePrompt: Child backpack on bench with soft morning light, anonymous composition, no logos

items.heading: Senior delivery
items.description: Doorstep drops for neighbors who cannot stand in line — routed by volunteer drivers.
items.imagePrompt: Delivery tote at front door mat, respectful distance, suburban porch, no house numbers readable

content.headline: Meet Jamie — route driver on Saturdays
content.body: Jamie started after their own family used the pantry in 2022. Now they pack Friday nights and deliver Saturday mornings — your match funds the fuel and cold bags that make the route possible.
content.imagePrompt: Person loading insulated bags into car trunk in parking lot, sunrise light, documentary nonprofit style, face partially turned away for privacy

content.quote: The weekend pack meant my kids had breakfast before school on Monday — I could focus on the rent conversation without an empty fridge.

content.headline: Double your impact before the match ends
content.description: Prefer monthly giving? You can still unlock the match on your first installment this week.
